title: A released item's work branch cannot land after a re-claim: land's rebase conflicts on the item file and the run state needs a resumed worker session to reach returned
goal: land re-bases a re-claimed item's branch by taking the item file of origin/main plus the branch's own gate and note changes, and moves a claimed run with a finished branch to landing without a worker session
repro_reason: seen in SP-mut2pmu3 with BG-ouhonprv, BG-pwhlp2sy and BG-sa4pmxsl: each branch was rebuilt by hand (claim commit first, item file conflict) and a paid dispatch --resume reached returned; needs a released item with a pushed branch
notes: Seen again in SP-uz3rhdlq: BG-3mjif4cw was released after its worker left a branch, begin refused the local work/BG-3mjif4cw branch, tidy kept its worktree (item todo), and the way on was a re-claim on main plus git reset --hard origin/main and a cherry-pick of the one fix commit in the worker worktree.
